**STOP:** Do not describe an actual exploitable flaw, credentials, personal information, a real attack path, private endpoints, or unpublished sensitive evidence here. Use private vulnerability reporting instead.

## Non-sensitive question
Which abstract trust or governance boundary should be investigated?

## Synthetic example
Use fictional actors, fabricated nonfunctional identifiers and hypothetical effects.

## Expected safe behavior
What would falsify the stated claim?

## Author and sponsor
Separate human authorship from model-generated or model-assisted analysis.
